name: Abducted
author: Micheal MacLean (grimmrobegames); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: Abducted by grimmrobegames, a first-person dungeon crawler for the Game Boy made with GB Studio for the Game Boy Competition 2023: taken by the aliens, you have to find your way out of their ship. MIT license (github.com/mrmmaclean/Abducted).

descriptions.en: Abducted by grimmrobegames, a first-person dungeon crawler for the Game Boy made with GB Studio for the Game Boy Competition 2023: taken by the aliens, you have to find your way out of their ship. MIT license (github.com/mrmmaclean/Abducted).
descriptions.it: Abducted di grimmrobegames, un dungeon crawler in prima persona per Game Boy fatto con GB Studio per la Game Boy Competition 2023: rapito dagli alieni, devi trovare la via d'uscita dalla loro astronave. Licenza MIT (github.com/mrmmaclean/Abducted).
